purpose: The editable meaning-net inputs for the candidate seed — curated synonyms and manual IB accept/reject, INDEPENDENT of the registry. Grown as reads surface misses (the self-learning path). Loaded into cfg_candidate_rule; the candidate.seed step consumes it.
note: synonym = a gloss/word whose lemmas are candidates; accept = force a lemma_key candidate; reject = force a lemma_key rejected. Empty at first — the migration imports the bulk of the seed; these are the ongoing manual adjustments.
